bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+path,timeout=10) as r:
        return json.load(r)
assert get("/health")["ok"]
corpus=json.load(open("scripts/real-debug-corpus.json"))
ids=[c["id"] for c in corpus["cases"]]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==50
assert all(sum(c["level"]==l for c in corpus["cases"])==10 for l in range(1,6))
old=get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/realdebug_030c71fab13b4726b5222b3f523b2900")
if old.get("active_in_process"):
    assert old["case_ids"]==ids
    print("EXISTING_FIFTY_ACTIVE",json.dumps({k:old.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","current","summary","active_in_process")}),flush=True)
else:
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/start",data=json.dumps({"suite":"real-debug","case_ids":ids}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r:
            result=json.load(r)
            print("FRESH_START_HTTP",r.status,json.dumps(result),flush=True)
            assert r.status==202 and result["total"]==50 and result["corpus_digest"]==old["corpus_digest"]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print("START_HTTP_ERROR",e.code,e.read(2048).decode(),flush=True)
        raise
    s=get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+result["benchmark_id"])
    assert s["case_ids"]==ids and s["summary"]["total"]==50
    print("FIFTY_CASE_READBACK",json.dumps({k:s.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","current","summary","active_in_process")}),flush=True)
PY
